How to Check in on Your Friendships

You know your best friend’s coffee order, complicated family dynamics, and feelings about her boss. But you might not know whether she wishes you called more—or how much she appreciated that text you sent last week. “We have this expectation that friendships should be easy, that we should always be affirmed, that our friends are kind of there forever,” says Nick Fager, a therapist in New York.
